text:
incident-bot: PAGER -> PD-1: enterprise tenant 'Argo' experiencing elevated 5xx rate and latency in eu-central-1. Auto-escalation to oncall. Potential customer impact: API requests returning 502/504 and slow responses. Triage channel opened.
Carla (oncall): Acknowledged, taking command. tagging Jo + Robin. I'll run through the runbook and coordinate comms.
Jo (dev-sre): Looking at metrics: https://grafana.redwood/argus/eu-central-1 -> 5xx rate ~12% over 10m, p95 latency up 400ms. Error traces point to connection timeouts to dedicated backend pool argus-eu-central-ded.
Robin (netops): BGP and edge layer look OK. Ingress shows healthy sessions, backend pool is the suspect. Dedicated pool hosts hitting FD limits/connection exhaustion. Recommend immediate staged traffic shunt to warmed standby pool in eu-west-1 and reduce DNS TTL to speed cutover.
Carla (oncall): Agreed. Jo, runbook step 3 -> initiate warm-shunt. Maya, prepare a customer-facing note. Emily loop in Argus PM.
Jo (dev-sre): Executing warm pool scale and route change now:
```
# warm nodes scale
infractl warm-pool scale --tenant argo --region eu-west-1 --count 8
# set routing policy to prefer eu-west1 (weighting 70 eu-west : 30 eu-central)
route-manager set-policy argo --weights eu-west-1:70,eu-central-1:30
```
I'll paste status shortly.
Maya (support): Drafting customer message: "We're seeing elevated errors in eu-central-1 for Argo. We've routed a portion of traffic to standby capacity in a nearby region and are monitoring. No action required from your side. ETA 15-30m for stabilization. Will update here." Sending to Emily for approval. :phone:
Emily (acct exec): Noted. Pinged Argo PM & security. Need to confirm they accept cross-region routing for their workloads (data locality).
dns-bot: Applied DNS TTL override for argus.prod (zone *.argus.prod) -> TTL 30s (previous 300s). Changes pushed to CDN/authoritative.
Robin (netops): nsupdate + CDN weight change executed. CDN reports ~68% of requests now going to eu-west-1, ~32% returning to eu-central-1. Edge logs: `edge:client->origin eu-west1 now 68%`
Jo (dev-sre): Warm pool health checks passing, KV cache seeding in progress. Quick smoke: POST/GET flows on eu-west replicate expected responses. Error rate for overall tenant dropping to ~3.5% after shift.
Nate (infra): Warm nodes finished KV cache warm-up (all three cache shards seeded). Running drain on a subset of struggling hosts in eu-central-1 to avoid new connections: `hostmgr drain --pool argus-eu-central-ded --hosts h-12,h-13`
Carla (oncall): Good. Maya please post the customer-facing note now and pin to the thread.
Maya (support): Posted message to Argo support channel and emailed PM. Logged incident to the account timeline.
Emily (acct exec): Argus PM acknowledged — they accept temporary cross-region traffic for 2 hours, asked to notify when we switch back.
Jo (dev-sre): Current numbers: overall 5xx = 1.2%, p95 latency back to ~120ms. CPU on dedicated pool trending down. Recommend maintain shunt for 60-90 mins to observe stabilization and allow draining/restarts for problematic hosts.
Sam (ops lead): I'm taking incident command for the next hour. Carla handing off. Sam -> ACK. Please keep me updated every 15m and notify if 5xx >5% again.
Carla (oncall): Handoff complete. Sam, I left runbook notes and the exact CLI commands executed in the incident doc.
Robin (netops): Will monitor for DNS propagation anomalies and BGP flapping. So far clean.
Nate (infra): Starting controlled restart on two failing hosts h-04 and h-07 in eu-central-1 after drain completes.
Maya (support): Updated customer message: added note that we're performing targeted host restarts and will follow up with a postmortem within 48 hours.
Jo (dev-sre): After restarts + traffic shunt: error rate steady at ~0.8% for last 5m. Suggest keep current routing policy and TTL for now.
Sam (ops lead): Agreed. Maintaining shunt for 90 mins, then we will test incrementally moving weight back. If stable for 30m with <1% 5xx, start 10% increments back to eu-central per 5m.
incident-bot: PD-1 -> Severity decreased to mitigated state. Pager cleared. Continued monitoring enabled, on-call handoff to Sam noted. Will auto-close after 2h of stable metrics.
Emily (acct exec): I'll send a short client update summarizing actions + next steps and cc security/COMPLIANCE.
Maya (support): Leaving pinned artifacts: links to grafana panels, executed command diffs, customer comms.
Sam (ops lead): Thanks team. Keep updates in this thread. If any regression, escalate immediately. :thumbsup:
